BiblicalUsage: Tob-Adonijah was one of the Levites Jehoshaphat sent to teach in the cities of Judah. The king sent Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tobadonijah, Levites, with Elishama and Jehoram the priests, and they taught the book of the law.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mission is the story: a king who sends teachers, not soldiers, into his own cities, and Tob-Adonijah's name stands in the middle of the list. The King James joins his name into one word, Tobadonijah.
